48414.description: Joeun remembers everything that turned her life upside down. She remembers the man who helped her out at the darkest of times, who abandoned her while calling her cursed. She remembers her prince, who she had her first kiss with at the age of eight. He, too, abandoned her in one day. She remembers the strange black haired man who beat her mother up. Everyone said that she was cursed, and she wants to prove them wrong. Eight years later, Joeun finds a wallet. She is going to turn it in when her friend is caught by a gangster and lots of money is needed to save her. But the wallet owner sees everything, and decides that Joeun is his next target for revenge. But the wallet owner seems to be a cross-gender freak.

48420.description: Karina's childhood friend Ikumi-kun had moved away in primary school, but he is now returning because of his father's remarriage; not only that, they are next door neighbors! The volleyball club that she has joined as a manager of course includes Ikumi, but also another childhood friend, Yasu, Ikumi's older stepbrother Miyuki-san, and the demon-like Arisaka-senpai, all members with rich personalities. What will become of Karina's high school life?!

48421.description: Karina is the manager of the volleyball club at Hokuryou High, a first year student who is looking forward to seeing the Kudou brothers, who will be moving in next door. The brothers are both volleyball club members, with Ikumi-kun a friend since childhood and Miyuki-san a great ex-captain from three years ago.

48422.description: Houjou Takeko , age 27, is an ultra-competent secretarial manager at a large corporation. After work, she trades in her suit and horn-rimmed glasses for chic outfits and dances away at her favorite nightclub. Be it work or play, it seems Takeko is the perfect independent woman. But unbeknown to her colleagues, Takeko has a mysterious lover, Shi-chan, and through her eyes, we see all the pain, joy, uncertainty, and rewards of a relationship.

48423.description: Motoko confessed her love to Shinsei, he answered it by saying that he is now only interested in playing soccer. Motoko's health is not in good shape and she has to stay over at the hospital regularly. She's however, try to be with Shinsei as much as possible.

48425.description:
Dr. Uzuki, who works at a university teaching hospital, comes across in an alley and saves the Yakuza member Nonami after he's been shot. The next day, when Nonami shows up at the hospital, Uzuki is scared that he's come to make sure of his silence after he's seen the gunshot wound. But actually, Nonami, who misheard Uzuki's name and has mistaken him for a woman named "Suzuki", has forced a younger yakuza brother into being admitted into the hospital and order to find this woman, and they've started to search for this 'Suzuki'...

The timid rabbit-type doctor and the Yakuza with the chisled strength of a tiger - a law of the jungle love!

(Source: Nakama)

48427.description: During the school break, Morikawa Kasumi was walking with her friends, while they were stopping at the gift shop some girls misunderstood her for a boy called Morikawa. When the school started for another semester, she found out that there is a boy called Morikawa in her class. He looks almost the same as her. This manga is about Kasumi, her friend and her family with the story focus on Kasumi the most.

48428.description:
Heroine ni naritai is a three-chapter romantic comedy about three friends, Midori, Rui, and Sayoko, and their first experiences with being in love.

(Source: Brickme)

Also includes the one shot Kimagure Time Machine

48429.description: Murial always fall asleep out of the blue regularly. One time, she dreamed about a boy and a talking rabbit in a mystical land, Toys Hill. Since then, whenever she falls asleep, she keeps dreaming about him and his friends in the place. Who is this boy? Why does he keeps appearing in her dream and what is Toys Hill?

48430.description:
Akimoto Ai's life is fulled of accident and bad luck. One morning he found a woman lying unconsciously on the way to his school. Because of this he's late for class. At school he notice a new student in his class, Kiyokawa Kasuto keeps staring at him.

Later on he buys a flower bouguet, intended to visit that woman and Kiyokawa approach him and told him that that woman isn't dead yet, an information that only the cops and Akimoto knew about. Kiyokawa reveal that he can see spirit, and a spirit of that woman is behind Akimoto's back.

48431.description: A collection of short stories based off of the adult visual Kao no nai Tsuki.

title.romaji: Kao no nai Tsuki Comic Collection

48432.description:
Matsushima Shougo's dad has to move to the USA, but he doesn't want to move with him.
His dad's friend owns the Koyama boarding house, and he decides to move in there instead. To his surprise and dismay, he found out he'll be sharing with someone else, and his roommate is not someone who will give him a friendly welcome.
How will these two adjust to living with each other?
synonyms: Bad boys in boarding house KOYAMA

48435.description: This is a sequel/side story of Colorful Box.

title.romaji: Bokura wa Tsuyoki na Runner da!!

48436.description: Ryouta likes Miyako but she always be nice to Ryouta's older brother instead. One day Ryouta's brother got back from his University from Tokyo with his girlfriend.

title.native: 好きと言えない・・・

48437.description: Yuri is a busy girl. Aside from studying, she also has to work as a model. This requires her to skip classes. Her parent are dead and her only brother has gone missing in Central Asia. One day she gets a phone call from the immigration bureau about her brother - they need Yuri's confirmation if this man is Yuri's brother or not.

48438.description: Kanna was ugly and she had been treated badly from everyone aside from a man called Kousuke. Therefore, she decided to had plastic surgery on her whole body to win his heart and the rest of the world. Will Kanna overcome her insecurity and lack of confident after this?

title.native: カンナさん大成功です!

48440.description: This manga based on the second season of Gundam 00 is illustrated by Auto Taguchi and follows on from his manga based on the first season.

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダム00セカンドシーズン

48441.description:
a 4-koma manga about three sisters living in a downtown pawn shop.

[Source: Amazon.co.jp]

title.native: ななはん～七屋ちょこっと繁盛記～

48443.description: A 4-koma manga about the life n female office worker.

title.native: ワーキングガールの素
ももいろ倶楽部にようこそ

48448.description: It’s about school life and there are three girls and three guys but only the first guy and girl are introduced in the first chapter. The girl, Taeko, even forgets her own friends’ names, and the guy, Ushio, is also an airhead. They make a cute couple.

title.native: ういうい・days; ういういdays

48449.description:
A young boy discovers by accident discovers a young girl, whom claim to be a war machine during world war II, sleeping in a incubator when he walks out of a store. After seeing her naked, his nose bleed out blood that splashed on the girl, who is awaken then by the blood - her energy source which she claim (man's blood).

The adventure begins...

'The princess is sick. However, the world is beautiful.'

48450.description:
This volume is a collection of older one-shots written by Akaishi Michiyo.

Fair Lady wa Namida wo Nagasu:
Takagi Sena walked by Sawaki Yoshitaka's new car and heard the car crying out that it was sad. Thinking nobody would believe her as always, she decided to walk away, but...??

W (Double) --Kage no nai Gogo -- :
Swimming star, Ichinomiya Mao, was involved in a terrible near-death accident at sea, which ended her swimming career. Ever since, her boyfriend, Ozaki Ryou, has been acting strangely, and now, someone that looks exactly like him has started hanging around. The only problem is, nobody else seems to notice!

Sono Hi wa Kinyoubi:
Sano Azumi's life was saved by a mysterious teenage guy who nobody was able to identify. Years later, Azumi meets someone named, Hagimori Shuuichi, who looks extremely similar to the guy who gave up his life for hers. Is this just coincidence?

Vivian Lee ga Koroshita:
Kanzaki Yuna was found dead in her apt. one night from drug overdose. Kitajima Kouko, her stunt double, was found hovering around the scene. Did Kouko have a hand in Yuna's death?

6 byou no 9 gatsu:
Kanda Kimihiro's life is normal. He attends high school, loves motorcycles, and idolizes a popular model, Fujino Sakiko. He has a best friend, Nagae Seiichi, and a cute girlfriend, Ogawa Kasumi, who he has been dating for years. But when Fujino Sakiko appears at his house one day declaring to be his sister, the gears of his life silently begin to shift...
(Note: this one-shot has also been recorded in another tankoubon with the same title)

Labyrinthos no Yoru:
5 people randomly decided to share a taxi back home from downtown Tokyo one night. Unfortunately, the taxi was involved in a violent accident. When the passengers regained consciousness, the driver was dead, and the area around them was eerily silent. What happened to the rest of the cars? Why were there no ambulances or policemen?

title.native: フェアレディは涙をながす
title.romaji: Fair Lady wa Namida wo Nagasu

48451.description: Kimihiro's favorite model, Sakiko shows up in front of his room one day. While he's being confused, his dad's home and explain to him that Sakiko's actually his own sister. His parent are divorce and Sakiko left to live with Kimihiro's mom.

48453.description:
Corinne received a doll from her father, sent from abroad. When she went out to play with the doll, she met a boy and discovered a glass slipper charm. One day, the boy had to move away, and Corinne gave him a ribbon with her name embroidered on it along with the glass slipper charm. Just as the boy was leaving, Corinne witnessed a tragic car accident...... A promise tied to a special ribbon and charm is about to unfold!

(Source: Books.com.tw, translated)

48454.description:
Several hundred years ago, the son of darkness already regained consciousness, shaking heaven and earth, filling the nights with evil, the whole world trembled with nervousness... and in the Western Heaven at the edge of eternity, there's a legend about a six-winged angel who will awaken in a million years and save the world from its crisis. Will the legend really come true?

Volume 3 includes the oneshot story "The Fingertip Country"

title.romaji: Xingzhi Yi ☆ Yu Zhi Sha Eternity

48457.description: Tomoe Karuma is an up-and-coming mangaka whose supervisor is Ero Magazine’s Tanaka Atsuki. Though he imagined a cute girl named Tomoe, Tanaka is surprised to learn that in actual fact, Tomoe is a very geeky boy. Tomoe is a professional when it comes to creating sex scenes, but turns into a fish out of water when it comes to love. Tanaka offers to teach Tomoe all about love, but can the awkward mangaka learn about love in time to write about it?

48458.description:
A nightmare-devouring tapir becomes stuck in Akane's dreams until she can feed him a proper nightmare.

Note: Published in LaLa 2009-12

48462.description:
Kaya and Hiyo are utterly smitten with Oto, who's as stunning as a French doll (but has a manly personality). Determined to give the beautifully grown Oto proper sex education, they start teasing him while he sleeps!

From a cherry blossom spirit who can't contain his lust, to a plump-butted kashiwa mochi, to a shy werewolf who transforms when aroused, all the way to a five-person angel orgy: this volume is packed to the brim with love and eroticism covering all aspects of life!☆

(Source: Libre, translated)

1. Harukoi Sakura (春恋さくら); Magazine BE×BOY 2007-03
2. Kunpuu Tango (薫風端午); Magazine BE×BOY 2007-05
3. Paradisso; b-BOY Anthology: Ero-hon♥
4. Sweet Dog Food (スウィートドッグフード); Magazine BE×BOY 2007-09
5. Suki yanen! (すきやねん!); Magazine BE×BOY 2008-03
6. Shitai nen! (したいねん!); kakioroshi extra
7. Omake (おまけ)
synonyms: スウィートドッグフード

48463.description:
A collection of short stories:

• Sword Breaker
• Yashakitan
• Mobile Morals - Ch. 1 "Silver Fang"
• Mobile Morals - Ch. 2 "Feeling of Love"
• Mobile Morals - Ch. 3 "Rondo"
• Aegis Maiden
• Elf Assassin
• Demon Code
• Dream Seen In The End

48464.description:
"Please let me stay here." Wakana is confused.Takayashiki Yukarino, her classmate, an heiress of the rich tycoon family, came to her house and begged Wakana to let her stay at Wakana's house.
Why did she run away from her home and why did she choose Wakana's house? They barely talk to each other, let lone know each other.

48465.description: Misato wish for an angel to come help her succeed in her love . That night a real angel came out to her bedroom.

title.native: えんじぇる・まじっく

48466.description: Mochizuki Hana has a crush on Hibino Sentarou, a novel writer when she first saw his picture on the back of the book's cover. One day she found out that a mysterious guy in her dad's monjayaki shop is him.

48467.description: Miguel, a nine-year-old Peruvian boy, was adopted by Riko Sannoumaru’s father. He moved to Japan and grew up amongst the loving Sannoumaru family. Now a high school student, new adventures of basketball and kyuudou await him.

48468.description:
Twilight is the time for the demon. A tribe that has been forgotten for a long time is slowly make some movement in today world....

Marie heard a cat meowing, when she follows the voice, this events leads her to a chain of events that will forever change her life.

title.native: 逢魔ヶＢＬＵＥ; おうまがブルー

48469.description: Princess Ruri is in trouble. Her dad, the great general of the powerful Fujiwara family is trying to set her up to married with some noble man. Ruri is 16 years old now, in the Heian era, she's getting old to get married, however, because of her personality, everyone see her as an odd princess. Lucky for her, Taka-akira, her childhood friend doesn't mind marry her and the wedding date is set. However, on their wedding night, something comes up to halt their big day.

title.native: なんて素敵にジャパネスク

48471.description:
The metropolitan police have a special squad of negotiators for talking down violent criminals in hostage situations and so forth. The two top negotiators have great knowledge of human psychology and experience in dealing with criminals, but they are missing something important.

They are searching for someone who is capable of agape love-- unconditional and selfless love for all people. Such a person would be able to develop rapport easily with criminals, and therefore be a natural negotiator. Instead of finding a person like this on the police force, they find her in the form of the teenage girl Haruka. Will they be able to persuade her to become a negotiator for the police?

title.native: アガペ; アガペ 犯罪交渉人一乗はるか; アガペ -犯罪交渉人

48472.description:
Wanna be killed by the assassin Sonya!? For some reason, Sonya, a girl assassin working for a shadowy organization, attends a perfectly ordinary school. And then there's Yasuna, the fearless airhead who just won't stop clinging to her. Together, this duo deliver's razor-sharp killer gag comedy in 4-panel format!! These lethal knives are absolutely addictive!!

(Source: emaqi)

48473.description: In this city, there is a legendary thief. An eccentric thief who lived down through the generations. A story that's told for generations. His name is Mugensai Ishikawa.

48474.description: Back in high school days, Makoto fell for Natsume (a glassed, short-haired girl) at the first dialogue with her. He even applied for a less competitive major of the same college just to be with her, but unfortunately she was not admitted. Makoto helped Natsume to retake the exam and the two became a couple naturally. The story follows small romantic events in their and their close friends' daily lives.

title.native: 恋愛ディストーション

48476.description:
A collection of short stories about girls being raped.

1. The bad dream of the midsummer
2. Move
3. The end of the foxy woman
4. Family...
5. A night light
6. The secret (First part)
7. The secret (Second part)
8. Play and trap
9. Catch, restrict & rape
10. Cicada drizzling rain

48481.description: This vase is a magical vase from China...It's a destiny or it might be faith. Shiki's mom is married with another man. Her new dad is rich but aside from studying, she still have to do house chores and gardening for her new house. Lucky for her, she has someone that will take care of her. His name is Fei Long and he came out of the vase!?!

48482.description: A self-published one shot, by Shintaro Kago.

48485.description: A fox saves a little rabbit from being eaten by the wolf, but he's asking for something in return.

48492.description: Takaki loves ranking the popular and beautiful girls at his school. The one standing at the top is the foreign transfer student Emilia Shutrause, and being a student from Europe, she is extremely popular among the male students at Takaki’s high school. Although he was just a spectator of this school idol, that would change when one day he accidentally bumps into Emily (Emilia’s nickname) and he finds out her secret...

title.native: プリンセス　スクール

48493.description: When he was in jr.high, Kuroi Teisuke overheard his friend that he has crush with that she likes people with deep voice, so he plans to confess his love to the girl he likes when he has his voice changes. Unfortunately, even when he's 16 years old but unlike other boys, his voice hasn't change yet. What he should do? And what about mysterious boy and girl that came up to him? Who are they?

48494.description: Isao is found in the school's gym. He's wrapping himself up with a sheet of clothes and will do that everytime when he's in the dark. There's someone hunting him down. Why does he 's being chased and what is so special about him?

title.native: イチゴとメロンとオバケ

48495.description: Yuuki get a the part time job in a summer, hoping that it'd be fun. 3 days had passed, but nothing interesting happened. One time she sneaked in to the actress's dressing room and met 2 suspicious guys who delivering a message from another famous actor. Who are they and will Yuuki will find something fun to do instead of her current part time job?

48496.description:
At the infamous QP club, the club for Quality People, it is always surrounded by high school girls who wants to join the place in order to get close to the 2 hot club members.
Sadly, because of the girl fight incident in front of the club, and because it's a club for supernatural researching, the club change its policy that from now on the only people who can be a member of this place must have supernatural power within them.
Among the rarity, there are only two girls who can get in this club, and they are Agawa Chihiro and Kishida Ai. See what t kind of incidents they get into after they got in this club.

48497.description: A scholar with absolutely no desire to study met a mysterious girl called "Miss Ugly" who had no memories of her past. She resigned to fate that she was destined to be sacrificed to the Huang Deity, but the scholar was determined to save her.

48502.description: Based on the video game. Kagura returns to her old school after three years abroad, eager to play the forterre with her old tutor again.

48503.description:
Proud to be a Samurai, even though I'm destitute

Harata Hiroshi chronologies 1970 - 1971

title.native: それがし乞食にあらず

48504.description: Youta is in high school but his voice still hasn't changed yet. He has a twin sister and her characteristic is drastically different from him. She is a new singer in an entertainment world and she's packed with confident. Youta admires his sister and thinks he never be as good as her. However, one day his twin sister got ill, and have to have a surgery. So Youta is indirectly forced by his twin sister's manager to pretend to be his sister until his sister gain full recovery on her health. This is a story about how Youta going through his self discovery with a main event in this manga.

title.native: ブラザー・サン シスター・ムーン

48505.description: Since he's 5 years old, Tokukawa Sunao spent his childhood with his dad who's an explorer in Africa for 10 years. He never go to school because his dad is the one who teach him everything. However, his dad went missing and now he moved back to Japan to live with his mom who is a famous actress instead. Follow the story of Sunao and Friends in this manga series.

48506.description: Azayoshi lives in an empty world, there is no hope or happiness, all she wants is a person who will never leave her side. Suddenly Ai steps into her dark world. To her he was her love. But what will happen when he discovers Azayoshi's past? Why is she keeping secrets from Ai?
synonyms: First Love - Anata ga Watashi wo Sabishiku Saseru

title.native: First Love〜あなたが私を寂しくさせる〜
title.romaji: First Love: Anata ga Watashi wo Sabishiku saseru

48509.description: Touko's friend dragged her to go to the psychic.The fortune teller there told her that the spirit around him will move the pen and write down the customer's name's future boy friend. When it's Touko's turn, the Psychic's name came out. Tougo's furious and excuse Reiki for being a fraud.

48511.description:
When the alien Mimics invade, Keiji Kiriya is just one of many recruits shoved into a suit of battle armor called a Jacket and sent out to kill. Keiji dies on the battlefield, only to be reborn each morning to fight and die again and again. On his 158th iteration, he gets a message from a mysterious ally--the female soldier known as the Full Metal Bitch. Is she the key to Keiji's escape or his final death?

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: All you need is kill - Cuộc chiến luân hồi
Na Skraju Jutra: All you need is kill
オール ユー ニード イズ キル

title.native: 保健室のオオカミ少年

48517.description: This is a sequel of Onnanoko no Fu-shi-gi. Reiki has already joined the band, Northern Cross and their relationship start​ to get shaky again.

48519.description: At Academia, a space colony intended to be the world university, a place that gather college students from all walk of life, a group of scientist finally succeed in inventing a time machine and here are the stories of how it leads to many people's life in this colony.

title.native: アカデメイアの冒険者

48527.description: There’s a deadly poisonous snake. Though, as long as you don’t touch it, you wouldn’t have to worry. No matter how deadly its poison is, as long as you don’t get involved with it, there shouldn’t be a problem.

title.native: 毒ヘビさんにご注意を

48528.description: A girl visits a dog shop owner everyday, and suddenly is confessed to by the scariest guy in school! What is she supposed to do?

48537.description: It's been a month since she entered high school, and Jun has started noticing a particular guy hanging around her classroom. When he suddenly confesses, she's not sure where she even knows him from--or how she feels about him. But come what may, he seems pretty intent on sticking around...

48538.description: Taepung is born of a rather prestigious family. But he is practically neglected by his father. And while he is purposely being beaten up by a gang, he decides that being beaten up is not much better than living. And then a ghostly girl with a strange voice rescues him. But the girl steals his precious necklace just like that--and when he finds her again, she is a fortune-teller girl who seems to be possessed. What will happen between these two? (Source: Acacia15)

48539.description: Shiina lives within the temple's area and she can sense spirit. Whenever there's some spirit nearby, her breasts will  be lifted up by themselves. One day, she and her friend accidentally moved the tombstone in the temple's graveyard, waking up the cat demon who is trapped down there.

48540.description: Ayame discovered that she's the descendant of the demon, since then she's being hunted by a group of demon hunter, Astersik.

48542.description:
Ninomae (Iko) is a tom-boyish girl who recently transferred to the Saint Stella School. Her new roommates, Shitanaga (Niko) and Shinomae (Miko) are just the kind of girl Iko wants to surround herself with to become more girlish. Iko soon learns from her classmates about a rumored object called the Chalice that grants wishes. It was originally stored in an abandoned church on campus but recently, it has been stolen, much to Iko’s dismay. The three roommates go to the church to investigate the missing object where they meet 2 mysterious figures Siren and Reverse Cross who have the Chalice. However, they escape before the girls have a chance to question them.

Who are these mysterious figures that stole the wish granting Chalice? Who is Iko’s best friend Azuma, who is hospitalized? What is the connection between Iko’s search for the Chalice and her relationship with Azuma? Find out more by reading Death Communication.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: デス/コミュニケーション

48543.description:
In brief, the manga revolves around Sho and Ai, high school students in a rural area. With no interesting activities happening, everyone in the village lives dependent of each other. However, things begin to change when a new teacher along with his beautiful wife transfered to the high school. What's gonna happens between this two couples? Is there's a possibility of conflict arises? This manga also leads back to the meaning of what does love at the first sight really means.

(Source: RedMadness)
synonyms: Stay プリティ ファーストラブ

title.native: STAY プリティ First Love

48549.description: In ancient Japan the Gowa family create a demonic Armor in order to defeat their enemies. Hundreds of years later this armor is exploited by the Gowa in the development of Tactical Armor for military usage and the usurpation of Japan.

48550.description:
She has lots of friends-
but hasn't had that important conversation...

She has a boyfriend-
but there is another girl...

Family too-
Her family... the only connection is through blood.

That kind of average high school girl-
Saitou Aya is suddenly lost in Wonderland!

The white bunny boy talks like a child.
"You are my Alice. Our savior..."
Aya = Alice's "Chosen world"?
Her "real self" is...?

title.native: アリス∞ワンダーランド

48551.description:
Asch is the lost prince of a country torn asunder by prophecy. Cloned and replaced by a new prince, Asch finds himself amongst the ranks of God-Generals, fighting to destroy the very prophecy for peace that his clone will fulfill. War, magic & science clash, but at their heart stands Asch the Bloody.

(Source: Bandai Entertainment)

title.english: Tales of the Abyss: Asch the Bloody
title.native: テイルズ　オブ　ジ　アビス　鮮血のアッシュ
title.romaji: Tales of the Abyss: Senketsu no Asch

48552.description: Collection of shorts stories featuring characters from the otome game Starry☆Sky ~in Autumn~

title.native: Starry☆Sky ～in Autumn～ コミックアンソロジー

48553.description: 11 years ago, Eun Sung-min was one of the few survivors from a village that experienced the "Evil Phenomenon". He and his maid were saved by the mysterious Phantom King and his group, Phantom. Now the Special Environmental Protection Agency is searching for the answers to what happened on that fateful day, and how to combat the "Evil Spirits" that caused such mayhem.

48554.description:
In the blink of an eye, high school student Taku Shimamura finds himself transported to the bizarre world of Slaffleaze, where intelligent creatures govern and the ruling class, led by the villainous Zolba, is plotting the invasion of the world they know as Capricorn, the Earth. Joining together with the oppressed Slaffleaze peasants, Taku must find a way to stop Zolba's dark forces before the way to the unsuspecting Earth is opened. In order to do so, he must first gain the love and trust of the last of the Yappie, the ancestral guardians of Slaffeaze. This is a task that will take more than a little courage and daring, for the last Yappie is not just a cute young female, she's also a dragon.

(Source: Anime News Network)

48555.description:
In the waking world, he’s sickly and scared to speak in front of crowds. In a world filled with dangerous criminals and killers, he can’t swing a sword or shoot a gun. But in dreams, Nightmare Gottschalk is smooth, mysterious, and powerful. And he will do anything it takes to win Alice’s heart before someone else can come and steal her away. Romance takes on an intriguing new form in this sweet but dangerous love story between Alice the Outsider and this strange, contradictory Nightmare.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Alice in the Country of Clover: Nightmare
title.native: クローバーの国のアリス ～ナイトメア～
title.romaji: Clover no Kuni no Alice: Nightmare

48556.description: Do you believe in Soulmate? Himeki Sakura does. Sakura has a heart shaped birthmark on the back of her left shoulder and a psychic told her that her destined lover will have the same birthmark on the same position as her. Sakura's parent have to work abroad so she moved in with her aunt in another town and Sakura intended to find her destined lover here.

48557.description:
Former assassin Gray Ringmarc serves his master Nighmare in the Tower of Clover. Known for his mature personality and kindness to animals, Gray also has a dark side. When Alice is whisked off by an adversary, Gray’s inner darkness emerges in a fit of jealousy. Now there will be hell to pay. Can Alice tame his reptilian heart?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Contains stories that focus on Alice and Gray from Clover no Kuni no Alice and a short story from Crimson Empire.
synonyms: Clover no Kuni no Alice ~Tokage no Hosakan~

title.english: Alice in the Country of Clover: The Lizard Aide
title.native: クローバーの国のアリス ～トカゲの補佐官～
title.romaji: Clover no Kuni no Alice: Tokage no Hosakan

48558.description: A collection of stories featuring different characters from Quinrose's otome games—Arabians Lost, Heart no Kuni no Alice, Clover no Kuni no Alice, and Crimson Empire.

title.native: 恋愛おとぎ話～ショコラ・ドラジェ～

48559.description:
Megumi and Yuuko had to left Sendai and go to Tokyo because they want to study in a school with a dormitory. While they were walking in a street in Tokyo, people thought Megumi is a boy because of how tall she is and one man mistook her as his girlfriend's new boyfriend. Fortunately, she was help by a young man and unlike the other, he knows that she's a girl.
After Mugumi and Yuuko went to school for the first day, they found out that a man that help Mugumi is also a student in this school and his name is Wakatsuki. Megumi fell in love with him but before anything happened her best friend, Yuuko fell in love with him too. What will Megumi do?

48561.description:
Included Stories:
1. Sugao No Mama De (素顔のMAMAで, Mama's True Colors )
2. Eyes Wide Shut
3. Femme Fatale (ファム・ファタール)
4. Sakura No Koro (サクラの頃, Time of Sakura )
5. Dare Ni Mo Ienai (誰にも言えない, Don't Tell Anyone )
6. Okami (OKAMI~女将~, Okami Landlady )
7. BAD BOY (Bad Boy)
8. Dear Novelist
9. Cook Me Softly
10. MY FAIR LADY (My Fair Lady )
11. INCREDIBLE BOY (Incredible Boy)

48562.description: Eiri wants a cute cat as a reward from her parent. Her parent get a dog, a  Labrador Retriever puppy, for her instead and named that dog "Ken Ken". However Ken Ken behaves very well whenever he is in front of Eiri's parent but he is never nice when he is alone with Eiri. One day, Ken Ken got electric shocked accidentally. He passed out, and woke up with surprising outcome.

48564.description:
Midori just moved in with her father in a new town. Nervous about her new school and thinking back that she's well known among her friends that she cried easily, she promised herself that this time she will be strong and won't cry easily anymore. However, when she introduced herself to the class, she noticed that there's no one in her class is a girl. Midori's shocked and wondered why. Before anything happened, a fight between a teacher and a student in her class shocked her even more.

Soon, when she asked her teacher about this, she found out that she's the only girl in this school. Will Midori survived after this?

48565.description: A sexy and cool French restaurant boss, Sonobe Munekazu, suddenly appeared in front of Hisaya and took him home after saving Hisaya from his violent ex-lover. Hisaya started working in the restaurant later while staying together with boss. Love sparks flew and jealousy arose when the boss’s friend, Nagamori Kyou, appeared. Hisaya began to doubt himself and the boss. Was there a real reason for the boss to pick up a total stranger?

48566.description:
Hot demonic lords appear one after another, all trying to woo Haruka, a girl who has been all alone for her whole life! It is said that the demon lordwho wins Haruka's hand will become the most powerful tribe, but...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

48568.description:
From the Ultimate Manga Guide:

Rio Midorikawa and Usou Ogata took violin lessons together. The sound of Rio's violin reflects her talent and has a deep effect on her audience.

title.native: おしゃべりなアマデウス

48570.description:
In the future, any mood you want is just a pump away. People flock to legal “pump bars,” where licensed medical professionals, known as bar doctors, prescribe their customers the perfect pharmaceutical blend.

But when the standard dosage isn’t enough, our protagonist, Cub, turns to an unauthorized source. The results have to be seen to be believed.

Rendered in a richly-detailed, clear-line style, this psychedelic sci-fi manga tears apart the basic fabric of reality. What is the truth and what is a dream?

(Source: Last Gasp)

48571.description: One girl, Hajin Seo. She tries to wash her past away, a past filled with murder. But she cannot. A teen star, who just happens to be infatuated with her, tries to cheer her up. But the only two that can cheer her up is Mina, the girl she thought she killed, and a black haired boy. Once the leader of many, all three will become fallen ones.

48572.description: A really unfashionable working class girl, Chen Xin Yi, desires to tie down her handsome boyfriend to be with her. during a trip on a love cruise, but ends up sick and drowsy due to the medicine, which causes her to enter Ji Cun Xi's room instead of her own. Cun Xi is the sole male heir to his family's company and has been in love with his girlfriend, Anna, for a long time. He planned to propose to Anna on the boat, but she didn't turn up. An island owner added drugs into Cun Xi's drink, and Cun Xi became disoriented and returned to his room. Xin Yi and Cun Xi end up having a one night stand. Xin Yi later finds out that she's pregnant, and Cun Xi's grandmother forces them to get married. Will a couple forced to marry for the sake of their unborn child find love with each other?
synonyms: Ming Zhong Zhu Ding Wo Ai Ni

48574.description:
Yuuta's grandmother died and on the last day of his grandmother's funeral, amidst the gossip of the relative about who will adopt him, someone spoke it outloud "I will raise this kid." Who's she? She is Meguri Ichiko, the main character of this series.

With posh brand named clothes and her attitude, no one would believe at first that she's a detective, an assistant inspector for the Narcotic Department for the Metropolitan Police Department. Aside from her work, Ichiko does take another thing seriously at heart, that's a man with 5E. 5E? What is 5E....?

48579.description:
Nagase Yuuya always gain the highest test score in the school. One time, he got the 2nd rank and missed the chance to be an exchange student to go to the USA. His friend is frustrated and said that Yuuya is intended to do this to help another people that wants to study abroad.

She then handed him a sheet of paper, an announcement from the movie production saying that they need Yuuya to have a 2nd round audition for their new film. It appeared that his friend sent his picture to the judges without him knowing it for the first place. Yuuya is however, doesn't want to hurt his friend's feeling so he go there and expect that he'd fail the competition anyway. The road to Yuuya's life in show business is about to start.

48581.description: When it comes to competition, Kaoru always lucky with it. Except for once, during her high school year when things didn't go as she had expected. Now Kaoru is graduated from her college and is ready for work. Just before her job interview, her past comes back and haunted her. Will Kaoru be able to get over her past?

title.native: ロマンチック･バーバリアンズ

48582.description: Follow the story of Clancy Flint, a private detective, along with his 2 friends, the president of a research & investigation company and a lawyer, go through a series of events.

48584.description:
Ryouma 's sister opens a restaurant and one day some thugs came in their store to eat her food and left without paying. Ryouma and those thugs ended up fighting using knife as a weapon. During the fight some mysterious guy threw in a can of beer, and made those thugs lose their balance and lose the fight. They ran away.

It turned out that a man who helped Ryouma is an old man. When Ryouma thanks him, that old man challenges him for a knife fight. He introduced himself as a principle from Ajikari Academy.

Ryouma's sister doesn't want them to fight but turned out the fight is about who is the fastest one that can peel an apple. The old man said that if he won, Ryouma must do what the old man said. Ryouma lose to the old man and now he has to enter Ajikari Academy. Ryouma's experience with various kind of food is about to start from now.

48585.description:
This is a heart-warming collections of short stories following a group of individuals who are bound by the red string of fate and are searching for love, in any one of its countless forms.

Will any of these men find what they're so desperately searching for? Hino and Takechi are co-workers hurled into the unknown when they're suddenly abandoned during a company drinking party. Was it all just a drunken mistake? Tetsu is a nursery school teacher who is enamored by Natsume, his student's older brother.

Is age really the only problem here? Yoshiya and Hisaya are siblings whose family was torn apart by failure. Can they mend their family's broken bond? Asahi travels to his hometown for his high school reunion, is delayed enough to miss it, and then bumps into Kanji, the only person he wanted to see. Is fate cruel or kind?

(Source: DMP)

48586.description: Edo period, a young draftsman, Sutehachi, arrives at Katsuhika Hokusai's house, the genius of the print and his daughter O-ei. If the boy's passion for drawing does not give way to that of the master, haunted just like him by the passion of the print, he is also very attracted by the world of pleasures.

48587.description:
Ark is a boy that has lived his whole life in the secluded underworld village of Crysta. Even though everyone else is content with their lifestyle, Ark's desire is to know what lies beyond.

One day, a voice coming from a secret basement of the elder's house calls for help. Ark, being the only one who heed the call finds Pandora's box, releasing both a curse that freezes the entire village and a strange creature. It is here that Ark's journey to restore his village and the world beyond starts...

(Based on 1995 ENIX snes game Terranigma).

48594.description:
Imagine a modern day where the Sword Abolishment Edict of the Meiji period was never enacted. The descendants of samurai are allowed to carry swords, and they gather at the famous boys' high school Shiseikan. Among them is the antisocial 10th-grade swordsman, Haruma Konkonoe. The poor swordsman, Ibuki Takahara, has transferred to Haruma’s class. Their fateful encounter will slowly melt Haruma’s cold, hardened heart.

(Source: Bookwalker)

48597.description:
Since he was little, Chihiro has felt an unusual emotional connection to zombie movies. It's not that he feels bad for the survivors—instead he fantasizes about comforting the poor undead girls they slaughter! When his beloved pet passes away, he decides to brew up a resurrection potion in secret. But he's discovered by popular girl and local heiress Sanka Rea, whose life isn't as perfect as it seems ... and Furuya suggests that she could serve as a test subject!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

48606.description: The events take place during the Great Exhibition of technological breakthroughs in Victorian England, in mid-nineteenth century. Ray is a boy, the son and grandson of two great inventors, and since he was a little boy he dedicated himself to create amazing machines driven by steam power. One day his grandfather Lloyd returns from the United States, where he is working with his son to a secret project called for the multinational Ohara Foundation, and handing the boy a metal ball that can produce an immense energy. This marks the beginning of the adventures of the boy, who from that moment it will be hunted by the henchmen of the U.S. company and its competitors, eager to retrieve the precious item needed for their major project: the imposing Tower Steam, the ultimate war machine . A clash of generations between father, son and nephew, their world views and values of life, a brilliant critique of modern society and war.

48607.description:
This collection of short stories features a variety of tales about dogs, including the exploits of “Justice,” a vigilante group made up of pet dogs; the coming-of-age story of Ron, a timid family dog who sets out on a journey in search of freedom; the love and courage that Kenta, a bullied boy, learns from a stray puppy named Shion; and the author’s deep affection for his own wolfdog, Hanako!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

Stories included:
2. Mel no Tabidachi (メルの旅立ち, Mel's Trip); Manga Goraku Super Special Issue
3-4. Lonely Ron (ロンリーロン, Lonely Ron); Shounen Sunday Zoukan 1992-09, 10
5-6. Shion no Kaze (シオンの疾風, Strong Winds of Zion); Monthly Shounen Ace 1996-02, 03
7. HANAKO (HANKO); Weekly Manga Goraku

title.native: 銀牙伝説ウィード外伝

48614.description: Jiya is an alien and a galaxy patrol member on a mission to Earth. His first encounter with humankind is rescuing a rich party girl, Kaede, and her chauffeur Kyuumonji Yukio from mountain bandits. Using Kyuumonji's body as a host, Jiya is going to check out rumors of a recent infestation of "vampires" on Earth that are attacking beautiful young women.

48616.description: Sold by his parents to a brothel, Yuki is placed under the care of the mysterious Shirogane. Shirogane, who is known for his skill at training young boys to satisfy customers with their bodies, pleasures Yuki every night and introduces him to the debaucherous world of carnal pleasure. But on the night Shirogane declares Yuki ready to receive customers, Yuki cries "I only want Shirogane... please go all the way...!"

48619.description:
There’s a New Heroine in Town.

Rinka Urushiba’s world is turned upside down when she wakes up one day-after falling right through the floor.Encouraged by another ESPer who believes that Rinka’s destiny is to become a hero of justice, she soon learns to use her powers for good. And not a moment too soon, as those with less-than-admirable ambitions descend on Tokyo with their own sets of superpowers. As the mysterious glowing fish flitting through the city skies gift powers seemingly atrandom, foes become friends and alliances are made and broken.And what about that flying penguin?

(Source: Kodansha)

48621.description:
This volume contains three chapters. The first two are extra stories for Hustle de Ikou, while the third is an extra of Tonari wa Scramble.

• Anata ga Paradise
• Sekai wa Anata no Tame Ni
• Tonari no LIAR
synonyms: Sekai wa Anata no Tame Ni

48623.description:
At Inokashira High School, Kouichirou is assigned by his teacher to take care for the welcoming party for the female foreign student from Hong Kong who is going to study in his class. While he's having headache with the class's condition, he heard something loud. The source of that noise are one huge Helicopter and 3 more planes, and the girl who step out from that helicopter? She's Fang Ran, the heiress of the Chang Family, the richest family in Hong Kong.

Fang Ran noticed Kouichirou and asked him for the direction for the Teacher Room, and soon she's introduced by the teacher in Kouichirou's class. Fang Ran remember Kouichirou and so she greet him, which cause the teacher to assign him to take care Fang Ran from now on. Read the story about Fang Ran, Kouichirou and their friends in this series.

48628.description:
A collection of stories by Kei Matsuzawa

1. Magical Investigator Greedia #1
2. Magical Investigator Greedia #2
3. Magical Investigator Greedia #3
4. Magical Investigator Greedia Final
5. Welcome To Mercurial Girl's Academy
6. Beast Princess
7. Fighting Maiden Squad Lightning Pitch
8. Galaxy Detective Arisa
9. Twin Sweets - Fallen Angel's Duet
10. Treasure Hunter Jerica ~The Final Door~

title.native: 魔法特捜グリーディア

48629.description: People say first love is the hardest to forget... And it is, at least for Hiroto. As much as he wants to, he just can't get Wataru out of his mind and heart. That guy next door, who is five years older than him, now even has a lover, and clearly is not interested in him. Hiroto has to learn to live with it... and with Wataru as his roommate, forgetting will certainly be the hardest thing to do.

48630.description: Angst filled and roughly drawn, yet visually intense manga by Renaissance Yoshida.
synonyms: The Withering of the Akane Shinchi Flower Shop

48637.description:
In the near future, in a not so distant place, there exists a society where law is based upon deterrence and criminals are assigned "obligations" fitting for their crimes.

Within this society, a man named Morita Kenichi aspires to the position of Special High Class Individual, one who holds authority over said criminals. For the purpose of fulfilling his ambition, Kenichi returns to the town he once called home. There he will encounter three girls bearing "obligations" and there he will encounter the past he left behind.

Won't you join him in this story about how people relate to their society? In this story about how a society relates to its people? In this story about the girl amid the sunflowers growing in the country spinning like a wheel?

title.native: 車輪の国、向日葵の少女
title.romaji: Sharin no Kuni, Himawari no Shoujo

48640.description:
This manga is a sequel of Jungle Boy manga. This time, the story is focus on Takimoto and Kousai's relatoinship and a bit of back story about Takimoto's brother.

The last part of the manga is a one shot called Partita, about A boy, Shinya and Satoru and their trouble about family life.

title.native: 君の手を離さぬように

48641.description: Penta, the King Penguin, lives with his boss, Kanda Junichi, a novelist. Junichi can listen to Penta talk and seems to be the only man that can understands him. Next to Penta and Junichi's house, there's a girl next door whom Junichi fell in love with, but Junichi is afraid to confess his love to her because of age different. Will Junichi find enough courage to tell the girl his feelings? How will their relationship end? And how Penta have a role in this?

48642.description:
Once upon a full moon night, Purin and her boyfriend flew from the moon to the earth on a date. The wind was strong and they got separated away. Purin is firstly, picked up by a girl, mistaken her for a stuffed toy. In fact she and her boyfriend came from a moon and they can use magic to grant people's wish.

However, Purin is still amateur and she can only use huge magic spell only on a full moon night. She's also need her boyfriend's power to help them go back to the Moon.

Read the story of how Purin helps each girl that met her succeed in love and follow her journey to find her boyfriend.

48644.description:
Hitto Tamaga, an 11-year-old boy, lives in some town in Japan. He is a very unfortunate boy, whose only asset is brightness. He lives only with his father who is a Bedaman researcher, but he left home several months ago, and he's been missing since then. He is living alone in a hut built on a relative’s land. Nobody celebrates his 11th birthday...except his cousin Nana who lives in the same land. One day, Hitto receives a present from the lost father, and he is very grad to know that his father remembers his birthday. It is “Crash Bedaman” that he longed for. After he puts them together to complete Crash Bedaman, he brings it to Bee Park, or a battle field of Beedaman. A battle there shows him a new way he should go.

There is a message from his father with the present.

“Overcome the difficulties”.

Putting this word in his mind, he beats the enemies one after another with his Bedaman. With the encounter of partners and rivals, the mystery of Bedaman, a shadow organization, and the reason of the missing of his father gradually come to light. Defeating various obstacles in his way, he’s growing up.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: 爆球HIT! クラッシュビーダマン

48651.description: Three thousand years ago, a sect of ancient Indian priests who sought world peace and justice, developed an unimaginable fist and sent their disciples throughout the world. Their mission, passed on to their descendants, was to live in the shadows of history and judge the evils of this world where the law cannot judge! They are the Family of Brahman!

48652.description: A side story/sequel of Koyamasou no Kiraware Mono by Nakaji Yuki. This manga talks about the how each couple's relationship progress after what happened in its prequel.

48653.description:
Ushio's father own a manufacturer company for mens wear and he expect Ushio to carry on his business. The idea Ushio doesn't like much.To him, this is pressure he have to listen to everyday.

Ushio has a distant cousin called Ren, who is a French Japanese model. Ren lives with his grandmother in French but now he has to move to Japan for his modeling work and he has to live in the same house with Ushio.

48654.description:
A side series of Young Kindaichi's case file. The cases in this series are:

1. "File 1 The First Case of Young Akechi/Alternative title: Farewell, My Dear Friend" (FILE1 明智少年最初の事件, "Fairu Ichi Akechi Shōnen Saisho no Jiken"?)
2. "File 2 Quartet with Intent to Kill/Alternative title: The Perfect Violinist, Akechi" (FILE2 殺意の四重奏, "Fairu Ni Satsui no Karutetto"?)
3. "File 3 Ghost Swordman Murder Case/Alternative title: The Pride Murder)" (FILE3 幽霊剣士殺人事件, "Fairu San Yūrei Kenshi Satsujin Jiken"?)
4. "Special Story Kengo’s Room" (スペシャルストーリー 健悟の部屋, "Supesharu Sutōrī Kengo no Heya"?)

(Source: Wikipedia)
synonyms: Akechi Shounen no Karei naru Jikenbo
Kindaichi Shonen no Jikenbo - Akechi Files

title.native: 明智少年の華麗なる事件簿
title.romaji: Akechi Shounen no Karei Naru Jikenbo

48656.description: Morishima Akiko's "Off Time" is about growing old with the one you love.

48659.description: A couple has trouble finding time to spend together because one of them is working overtime.
synonyms: The Power of Love: I Miss You

48660.description: Hilarious! The Hinomoto Kingdom's Princess Guard - an elite squad that directly protects their royal princess. Kasuga Haru was newly appointed to this prestigious position and was next to the Kingdom's one and only princess. There's only one problem. Their "royal princess" is a hikikomori, a recluse who stuffs her room with video games and refuses to leave even a nanometer out of her room. Kasuga's special mission given by the Queen is to make Princess Terras into a proper human. Can Kasuga succeed in turning this otaku princess into a proper princess full of charm and beauty?

48662.description: Harusuki Memorial. Nozaki can only pray, Dear god, don't let it be a dream...! Nozaki has a temp job helping set up a cafe. The assistant manager is the beautiful Kiriko. Nozaki doesn't think he has any chance with her--until the night of the staff party. Nozaki ends up walking a drunk Kiriko home. But she wants to "rest a bit"--at a love hotel! Please, dear god; don't let this be a dream...!

title.native: 恋するネイキッドガール

48663.description: Yazaki Yuuri, a transfer student, wants to be a popular high school kid. Also, despite how nerdy he knows it is, he's secretly working on writing a light novel. When strange things start happening around campus, an eccentric female student, Sakurabi Yukimi, explains to him that he has the power to unintentionally cause the creatures of his imagination to take physical form! Is it even possible for him to maintain his cool image while he's fighting the imaginary monsters from his formerly secret magic-girl light novel?

title.native: 妄想奇行～アドレッセンス・アバター～

48666.description: Six years ago, following a crushing defeat, a group of friends promised that they will one day take their friend Suzuo to the Koshien. Now in their first year of high school, the friends have reunited behind the pitcher Kitaro Kitaoji to keep their promise. With Suzuo as their manager and Kitaro's signature left-handed, underhand "Submarine Pitch," they may just go all the way.

title.native: 最強！都立あおい坂高校野球部

48667.description: Chiyako's brother, Takaya died in a fight. While everyone in the hospital is sad about his death, Takaya wakes up. Soon Chiyako found out that there's something different about her brother.

48668.description:
Side story of the Young Kindaichi Case Files. The cases in this series are:

1. "File 1 Testimony Puzzle/Alternative title: The Murder Train" (FILE1 証言パズル, "Fairu Ichi Shōgen Pazuru"?)
2. "File 2 Killing Poker/Alternative title: Unlucky Men in the Rain" (FILE2　殺人ポーカー, "Fairu Ni Satsujin Pōkā"?)
3. "File 3 Dead Person's Checkmate/Alternative title: The Great Chess Player, Akechi" (FILE3 死者のチェックメイト, "Fairu San Shisha no Chekkumeito"?)
4. "File 4 Ghost Hotel Murder Case/Alternative title: The Encounter" (FILE 4 幽霊ホテル殺人事件, "Fairu Yon Yūrei Hoteru Satsujin Jiken"?)
5. "Special Story Supt.Akechi Morning's Pretty Scenery" (スペシャルストーリー明智警視　優雅なる朝の風景, "Supesharu Sutōrī Akechi Keishi Yūga Naru Asa no Fūkei"?)

(Source: Wikipedia)
synonyms: Akechi Keishi no Yūga Naru Jikenbo

title.native: 明智警視の優雅なる事件簿
title.romaji: Akechi Keishi no Yuuga Naru Jikenbo

48669.description:
The author, who saw a microcosm of the world in the multi-racial nation of Yugoslavia, sharply depicts justice and human nature through the eyes of a boy involved in the guerrilla war against the Nazi occupation.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

48670.description: A super-deformed parody version of Kannagi created by the original author's brother, while Takenashi Eri was on sick leave which resulted in the suspension of the serialization of Kannagi.

48677.description:
Quincy wouldn't have seen this coming in her wildest dreams. What ordinary girl-next-door would? One minute you're sitting down to tea in your kitchen, talking with a friend, and the next-the man of your dreams comes knocking at your door, and he's looking for YOU.

Quincy never expected to be swept off her feet by a gorgeous, world-famous pop star, but now that it's happening, she's not sure she's the right one for him. Swept up in the glamorous thrill of it all, Quincy is worried that it's all happening a little too fast, not to mention her concerns that she's really not the right girl to call a sexy superstar her boyfriend. It's a good thing for Joe that his desire to be with her is as strong as his star appeal!

(Source: Dark Horse)

48681.description:
Original writer is Kitajima Takashi and mad into a manga by Kitagawa Miyuki, Lettuce to Ken is a manga about Satsuki who grow up in Kendou Dojo.

Satsuki has short patient and always end up in a fight with the bully. She knows Kendou very well because her father is a Kendou Instructor and he also own a Dojo. Satsuki's dad has had it with Satsuki so he send her off to stay over with her uncle at Kamakura.

At Satsuki's new school, the director is very strict and the Gym teacher here is abuse his power to discipline children by using physical violence as a corporal punishment. Will Satsuki make it in this school?

48684.description:
From the writer of the legendary BL game ESCAPE...

1. WEAK POINT: Koi no Arashi 2005 (WEAK POINT ～恋のアラシ2005～, WEAK POINT ARASHI'S LOVE 2005)
Although most lovers know their significant other's weaknesses, Yamato and Arashi are yet to show their vulnerable sides. Maybe all it takes is a little push from catching a bug. Gesundheit!

2. Innocence Labyrinth ESCAPE: IF (イノセンスラビリンス ESCAPE ～IF～, Innocence Labyrinth ESCAPE (IF))
Even though they're the same age, Yamato has always been more mature compared to Keisuke. He's always so cool and he knows so much... Will Keisuke ever get to know things like Yamato does? (Warning: dubious consent)

3. SURRENDER: ANOTHER ESCAPE (SURRENDER ～ANOTHER ESCAPE～, SURRENDER ANOTHER ESCAPE)
Motoki works part-time at a convenience store, and Etsushi is the store's manager. But that's all a lie Motoki tells his aunt and uncle to maintain his good boy image. In truth, the convenience store is actually a host club, and while Etsushi is still his manager, he's also his lover...

4. Warui Sensei (悪い先生, Bad Teacher)
Yamato is a student. Kensaku is his young and clumsy biology teacher, and his lover. Although Yamato is still young, he knows he wants to protect his lover even if he comes off as pushy. (Warning: student-teacher relationship)

5. Okashinafutari (おかしな二人, Strange Couple)
Yoshihiko Sena is a bishojo manga writer who hit it off with Yamato. The two are taking the night by storm, but what will Yamato do when he realizes he's overstepped a boundary?

6. Warui Seito (悪い生徒, Bad Student)
Mr. Tokiwa is Majima's algebra teacher. Mr. Tokiwa is also Majima's subject of love and desire. After being told by his teacher that they must wait until Majima graduates, can he handle being So close to him and yet, so far away? (Warning: student-teacher relationship)

7 .Shitto: SHIT! (嫉妬～SHIT! ～, Jealousy (SHIT!))
When Saotome's partner comes down with a cold on an important night, he reluctantly replaces him with Motoki. Will Saotome regret sending his own lover into one of Ginza's most prestigious hostess club? More like, how much will he regret it?

(Source: Futekiya, edited)

48685.description:
In the hometown of high school student Tachibana Reiji there has been an unusual string of suicides lately. Some people believe that this string of suicides might have something to do with the urban myth of "death accessories", which are magical objects that cause people to die soon after they pick them up.

Reiji, who lives alone with his adoring older sister Ayaka, doesn't believe this kind of nonsense, so he has no problem picking up a strange bracelet he finds on the street. Almost immediately, he finds himself forced to form a "contract" with his new bracelet. Now, in order to remain alive, Reiji must use the power of his bracelet to fight and kill others like him! His only ally in this new life is his sister Ayaka, who is determined to protect her little brother at any cost!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

48687.description:
"Why is my life so messed up?!"

Ha-Eun has a step brother who's a gang leader and she gets blamed for everything he does. When her brother makes it so that she is late for class, she has a strange encounter- the encounter that makes her a housemaid for the rest of the year. Ha-Eun, who hasn't even had her first kiss yet, decides to take revenge. But when she finally kisses someone -and it isn't pleasant- what will happen?

48688.description:
To help Poe, the lion cub that Ragi has been raising from going through some drug experiment, Adresia came up with the plan. She and Ragi sneaked into a lab where the time machine are being kept and tried to use a time machine to trasport Poe to Savanna.

By some accident, Adresia got transported to somewhere else 65 million years ago instead. Since then she has been considered a missing person.

Haunted and feel responsible by this incident, Ragi intended to go back in time to find and bring Adresia back. However, with his history after this incident, will he able to do it or not is still a question.

This is a side story of Academia no Boukensha and Inspector Syndrome (Bunko version).

48690.description:
A collection of side stories featuring the characters of the popular fighting game, BlazBlue released to promote the release of BlazBlue: Calamity Trigger.

A sequel under the name BlazBlue: Official Comics Vol. 2 was released in 2010 to promote BlazBlue: Continuum Shift.

title.native: BLAZBLUE オフィシャルコミックス

48692.description:
A collection of short stories.

1. Baby Dare yori Kimi ga Suki
2. Koi wa Ressha ni Notte
3. Itsuka no Kinema Paradise

title.romaji: Baby Dare yori Kimi ga Suki

48696.description: Kanazawa Noto joins Kitakou's broadcasting club on his first day of school. Hilarity ensues.

title.native: すすめ!きたこーほうそうぶ

48697.description:
On the sixth night, in the rose garden that was filled with loneliness and misery, I met my dead lover. He awakened me with those pale and lifeless lips of his, saying

"Do you love me" ?

"Yes, I love you"

A collection of stories portraying the cruel and twisted nature of love, lust and desire -- and the misery it brings to all those involved.

title.romaji: Han Lu Duanpian ji 1: Baroque Jian

48698.description:
1. Again, This Round's Story (Naomi, Watari)
Minami-sensei catches student Hamura stealing cigarettes. In exchange for not telling Hamura's parents or the police, Minami-sensei has a request he'd like the boy to fulfill.

2. Skill Up! (Naono, Bohra)
Hiroto is very talented in bed, always bringing girls back. His older brother feels inferior in everything and can't even bring himself pleasure. When Hiroto finds out, he offers to help his older brother because they are brothers, but does he have an ulterior motive?

(Source: tatereed)

48699.description:
Sensei rejected Fuji when Fuji confessed to him on graduation day. After that, Fuji always visited sensei and they still went out together. Sensei realized his feelings gradually and hoped to start afresh with Fuji. However, Fuji couldn’t believe it. But when Sensei’s ex-lover, Namiki, came back and wanted to reconcile with Sensei, both Sensei and Fuji found that they could no longer hide their own feelings anymore.
(from Attractive Fascinante)

title.native: 先生、キスしていいですか?
title.romaji: Sensei, Kiss Shite Ii desu ka?

48700.description:
In "Pure White Sigh," by Ogiura Tomoko, two broken-hearted women turn to each other for comfort.

(Source: Lililicious)

48702.description: Features stories "Nightingale wa Yoru ni Naku" and "Kangoku 69", original serialized in BOY'S Pierce.

48705.description:
Nonoka enters a new high school and is drafted into the high-end and rather bizarre Student Council by a “cool beauty,” Nozomi. What will this mean for the decidedly average Nonoka? Hijinx and Wackiness, of course!

(Source: Okazu)

48707.description: This volume is a companion piece to Hoshi no Yakata.  The third chapter is a prequel to the series, showing Sakurai's past before he became the master of Hoshi no Yakata as well as how the mansion came into his possession.  The remaining chapters feature short side stories that are more loosely connected to the main storyline of Hoshi no Yakata.

48709.description: Koudou and Takashi are lovers. But there’s one cause of uneasiness. Koudou is just a popular guy. One day, that uneasiness struck home!! A man who says he likes Koudou appears in front of Takashi…?!

48710.description:
Collection of short stories:

1. Moe Max (萌え♡MAX)
2. Moe Power (萌えPOWER )
3. Koihime no Yuigon
4. Joshi no Himitsu

48711.description:
When Nao was a little boy, he was friends with a little girl with the same name. But after a traumatic incident, they lost touch and the female Nao's hair turned white. Years later, a white-haired girl appears in male Nao's life. But does he even remember that little girl he used to know?

Note: Originally published in Dengeki Maou 2009 Aug. issue.

48717.description:
Mars knows that nothing will stop him from tracking down his wife, Chantal, who'd betrayed him and sent him to prison for a crime he didn't commit. Chantal had died--or so everyone said--but Mars knew she'd merely transformed herself and reemerged into the spotlight as supermodel Mischief Jones.
Mars was a hard man, a bitter one, who'd survived by shutting off his emotions. But when he finally captured the woman he'd been hunting, the bewitching seductress with the luminous eyes denied everything. He was falling under her spell. Who was she really --an angel... or a cunningly brilliant counterfeit with an agenda of her own?

Note: Based on Ann Major's novel, "Secret Child".

48722.description:
A (buff) karate champion is taken by his sensei when injured and unable to fully defend himself.

(Source: Sweet Lunacy)

48725.description:
This is a series of 4 one-shots by Asou Mikoto that all have a common theme of words and language.

Kotonoha ~Usuyou no Tsukebumi~ :
Maeda Kotoha joined the calligraphy club at her highschool b/c she was impressed by the club president Fujisaki's demonstration. Unable to gather up her courage to confess her feelings, he graduates. Feeling regret, Kotoha decides to write him a letter using a brush and traditional paper...

Kotonoha ~Ningyohime no Kowairo~ :
Manabe, a cool ice queen type of girl, in Fukazawa Tatsuhiro's class joins the swim team even though she can't swim. Intrigued, Fukazawa decides to teach her, but wonders why she wants to learn so badly...

Kotonoha ~Tenjousajiki no Naishobanashi~ :
Mihara Ritsu is a playwright for her school's drama club. Nakajima is an underclassmen who joins the club because he was moved by the lead actress Seto Miyabi's words in the final scene of last year's production. This year, Ritsu must write a play that stars both of them, but as usual, writing does not happen easily...

Kotonoha ~Shijin no Koi~ :
It all started when Sako accidentally picked up Kumazawa's book of poetry and secretly read what she wrote. A lot of it was humorous, but some poems were serious, particularly the ones that poignantly expressed her feelings about a certain classmate...

48726.description:
According to an old saying, all cats may start out with nine lives, but what happens when they begin to use them up? This story enters the secret world of cats, and begins where Yashio gives up one of his own to save Mikumo's life.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Kare to Kanojo no Futoumin (彼と彼女の不冬眠)".
synonyms: ยาชิโอะกับแมวสาวเจ้าเสน่ห์

48727.description: Kamina Erisu was hospitalized due to a car accident.  When she regains consciousness, it's apparent that she has lost her memory.  Even more surprisingly, however, every person she sees has a head of an animal instead of a normal human face, even her own father.  What happened to her to cause all of this and will she be able to see normally again?

title.native: アレゴリアのライオン

48728.description: Yukimine Kokoro is the only daughter of a very wealthy couple who has just recently passed away in a car accident.  Within days of the funeral, Kokoro's great uncle has directed her to pick a fiance out of a list of candidates he has prepared, since issues of inheritance have come up.  However, the shock of everything happening so quickly and rumors of a possible mystery around her parents' deaths have affected her mind.  Everyone around her appears to have the head of an animal instead of a normal human face, including her fiance candidates.  What is going on and how will she be able to choose under such strange circumstances?
synonyms: The Reindeer of a Folk Tail

title.english: The Reindeer from a Folk Tail
title.native: フォークテイルのトナカイ

48730.description:
Nanami is a girl who always liked Akira, but she thinks that the thing that got in the middle of their love was soccer, therefore she kind of hates soccer. One day Akira asks her to be the soccer school team manager and she denies it, but after that she is forced to be and after that their new sex lives begin a new cycle.

Included one-shots:
- Sunao na Pudding (素直なプリン); Comic Aun 2005-08
- Futari de Hitori (ふたりで一人); Comic Aun 2004-12
- Milk na Pudding (ミルクなプリン); kakioroshi

48736.description:
A Byouma is a medical weapon created by ancient sorcerers to kill the infected or those around the infected and make it look like an illness. Even centuries after the sorcerers have died, these weapons still wander the world, infecting and killing people. Narutaki Soutaro and Izumo Momo are Shadow Doctors, trained to combat these Byouma through unorthodox means. Using magically created anti-Byouma medical equipment, they perform “operations” on the medical weapons to separate them from their hosts and destroy them. Will their special weapons and brilliant teamwork be enough to get rid of all the Byouma in the world?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

48739.description: Life isn't that great when it's composed of a stubborn sister, single mom, and a dad that left you for someone else? If that's not enough, you meet a dwarf that's part of a famous boy band? Could this get any worse?!

48741.description: Kang Eun Woo is the infamous "princess" that Kang Joon Hyuk adores. Although many think she must be very beautiful because Joon Hyuk is also a hottie, she....just eats and sleeps (thats about it).Why does Joon Hyuk care for her so much? Well, I don't know, but touch her and prepared to be annihilated!

48742.description:
Who would have thought that Jung Areum, the beauty queen of school had a sister with no other hobby than stealing people's food??
Well this girl is no other than Jung Daum, whose number one fan of hers is the popular school idol Ju-Junk!! And WHO would have imagined that Jung Daum is head over heels in love with him??!! But of course, things don't go that easy... cause cute and two-faced big sister likes him too!!

48743.description: Lang Lang is a girl who was adopted by rich parents. She starts attending the school of her brother Ian, who is the idol of his school.

48744.description:
The main girl and her unrelated brother had always been together since their parents' unfortunate deaths.
On her brother becoming a policeman of another jurisdiction, they moved into a big house...only if it doesn't have its gloomy and haunted air.
They found a body of a dead young boy, a son of a hotel chain family. The ghost of the boy gives the girl the ability to communicate with ghosts.
Now the main girl's unrest life is turned upside down and more complicated. Not that she is in love with her brother...no, no, no way. Not because of the dead boy's younger brother. Not that her ability to see ghosts seriously gets her into trouble...."UGHhhhhhh, somebody help me!"

48745.description:
She has no father to call dad. She has no siblings to call brother. A girl with hardly any siblings. The smiling angel Choi Mi So.
Even if I am lonely, I stopped crying when I turned 12. Becasue WooJin oppa came into my life. However, there is a secret behind her smile. She isnt close with her mother? But she is close with the love of her life, Woo Jin Oppa? Then what about her boss? Yu Ri? Why is my life so difficult and complicated? I'm only 17 years old!!

48746.description:
1-3. 2-shuukan no Adventure

4. Himeko-chan

5. His Left Eye
A story detailing an encounter between Gerry and Eugene from Barairo no Hoo no Koro, as adults.

6. Belgian Waffle
Andrew, from Barairo no Hoo no Koro, takes a stroll with his old father, bringing about some surprising discoveries, aside from the fact that Belgian Waffles can be sweet.

48747.description:
Misunderstood in the dark, Na Na "saved" a girl from a "pervert." Now he has his eyes on her. He brought her many troubles continuously at school because he is a "hot boy" many likes.

Now, Na Na is determined to get revenge, but maybe she met her match...
synonyms: The Bear-Like Fox Meets The Wolf

48748.description: Hee-Yul Yoon has just moved back from America to Korea with her sister, Suh Hee Yoon. She is determined to deal with her hard past by leaving behind her aunt, uncle and her friend Ricky Ha. After buying a pack of cigarettes she bumps into a handsome boy. And then all of a sudden he kisses her! Who is this annoying bastard and what's his deal?! You had better believe that our heroine Hee-Yul will get to the bottom of this!
synonyms: They're Not Kissing, and a Cat

48749.description:
Seobang(1) my ass! Who's your hubby,
And who are you calling my manura(2) ?
Promise between households?
Pu! Who cares about that kind of thing!

Oh goodness, our neighbors,
Just listen to the way he's talking.
I'm telling you to keep the promise
Since it's a vow between two households!
It's not as if I've become your manura
Because I wanted to be!!!

Anakne(3) virtues are;
One: Carefulness of conduct, Two: Carefulness of conduct.
This is the way she was taught to act,
Genuine country maiden Kim Seon-Nyeo.
Because of resistance(?) from Cha Eun-Hyeok who is to become her seobangnim(4),
She gives up on trying to be the perfect wife,
And reveals her true nature
As a hot-blooded fighting art specialist!

Taming Jogang Jicheo(5)?
It's actually taming Jogang Jibu(6)!

(1) Hubby
(2) Wifey
(3) All of women
(4) "-nim" makes it to become a formal way of calling seobang(hubby).
(5) Wife who has shared one's hardships
(6) Husband (literal meaning father) who has shared one's hardships

48751.description:
Summer vacation has started and Yoshiyuki and his cousin, Takaharu are being tutored by Kurushima, who works for Yoshiyuki's brother. Though reluctant at first about having a home tutor, Yoshiyuki starts developing an attraction towards Kurushima. However, there's more to Kurushima than meets the eye..

(Source: Bliss)
synonyms: The Garden Where the Climbing Plant Grows

title.english: The Garden Where the Ivy Plant Grows

48752.description:
They Were 11 is about ten Galactic University recruits who have passed many levels only to be given one final test. They are told to travel to an ancient spaceship and live there, together, for fifty-three days. This is not a problem until the ten recruits, hailing from diverse backgrounds and planets, discover that there are actually eleven of them on the ship. In fact, this problem turns out to be the test, as they have to trust each other in order to survive, even though one of them is an impostor.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Won the 21st Shogakukan Manga Award for Shoujo in 1975.

48753.description:
Everything would have been perfect in the best of possible worlds if Death had not decided to come and pick up the hero's little sister. Despite being a kitten, he does not intend to let himself be carried away by this sinister character. Between fascination for the absurd, and immoderate taste for a sweet wickedness, Nekojiru stages Nyato and Nyata, who under their airs of cute little kittens, will set fire to the whole planet.

(Source: IMHO, translated)

Note:
-Originally serialized in Monthly Manga Garo for 31 chapters, starting with the 1990-06 and ending with the 1995-10 issue.
-Incomplete 2-volume tankoubon (23 chs) published by Seirindo in 1992 and 1995.
-Complete 3-volume tankoubon published by Bungeishunjuu in 1998 and 1999. This tankoubon collects all chapters with the exception of "□nugoroshi no Maki" (□ぬごろしの巻). It additionally includes 3 newly drawn chapters (one in each volume) as well as the One Shot "Nyango-tan" (にゃんごたん) by Nekojiru-y, originally published in COMIC Gon No. 3 (November 1998).
-The tankoubon releases change the order of the chapters. The credits on this entry are according to this ordering.
-The chapter "Neko Saiban no Maki" (ねこさいばんの巻) was published in English as "kitty court drama" in the anthology "Sake Jock" by Fantagraphics Books.

48754.description:
A collection of 3 stories:

1) The Beast and Harrian
The Beauty and the Beast with the manhwaga's own twist.

2) Across
Psychological and slightly supernatural pairing of an angsty couple.

3) Soft
A story revolving around roommate drama.

48758.description: In a society where money is king, the young men known as "flowers" hold a special role. In exchange for the financial support of those who have the means to patronize them, they serve their flower masters as symbols of taste, status, and wealth. Bought and sold at the whim of their masters, theirs is a precarious existence - save for the few who are lucky enough to have masters who can see the person behind the flower.

48760.description:
Anthology of one-shots by Sakurano Mika.

1. Hanjuku Hime
Momoe is the type who accepts everyone’s opinions without contesting them regardless if they are right or not. That’s why people around her tend to call her dumb or stupid. Never showing a hurt face she’ll always smile back at them and she won’t even get angry. Takasugi, the school’s idol, gets to know her after some meetings in the infirmary and he’s amazed by her lack of self esteem combined with a warm smile ready to be given to anyone. She also starts to feel attracted to him, but is love what Takasugi feels or only curiosity?

2. Oresama, Kaimasen ka?!

3. Kiss Friend
Emimi had had several boyfriends. However, she disliked any intimate contact with them. Whether kissing or even holding hands, she got disgusted and simply breaks away. One day, she realized that her long time friend, Shinji, did not gross her out and asked him to kiss her. That, of course, is the beginning of a romance.

4. Imakoi

5. Kaori-chan Himitsu Nikki
Kaori has quite the imagination when it comes to romance. In particular, she daydreams about cliche school romance scenes between herself and the boy she likes, Ryuu. One day she drops her diary and it’s picked up by the difficult and hard-to-approach Mayuki. Is this the beginning of a beautiful friendship, or fandom?

48763.description:
Ohtaka is pissed! University baseball is not what he expected, and it’s all because of Tweetie, the odd little person who blithely chirps and constantly circles in his tall shadow. Everything Tweetie does only deepens Ohtaka’s scowl. His irritation skyrockets when Tweetie demands Ohtaka stay in the baseball club for his sake and steals Ohtaka’s first kiss!

When two people from Tweetie’s past are thrown in Ohtaka’s face, his agitation suddenly turns territorial — and he’s not sure why…

Will Ohtaka figure out this unfamiliar game that plays for keeps? Get ready for a fast pitch of romantic comedy and surprising love in Tweeting Love Birds!

(Source: Digital Manga)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

48764.description:
Continuation of the story of Chihiro and Keigo from Harete Bokutachi wa.

After declaration of love from both. Now Chihiro and Keigo have started dating... but really what is the difference between best friends and boyfriends. Will the two of them learn in time the difference between friendship and love! Not to mention jealousy...

48765.description:
Satou Hiroshi is the kind of polite, innocent, cute boy who's popular with guys and girls alike. But word-of-mouth has it that anyone who dates him will be plagued by a series of unfortunate events and near-death experiences - eventually being forced to institute a break-up 'under pain of death'...

Will bespectacled, 'uncool', baseball-crazy Tsumabuki Kasumi prove these rumours wrong or experience them first-hand? But after falling for Hiroshi's cute smile upon their (rather weird) first meeting, he's determined to tempt fate and find out whether he can finally break out of this unlucky streak and strike it lucky in his love life!

title.native: 名探偵音野順の事件簿

48767.description:
1. Shinizokonai no Ao (死にぞこないの青)
A new teacher proves to be popular with the students and parents. But one of his students feels like he is picking on him deliberately. Around the same time, the student in question starts seeing a blue-skinned... thing that only he can see.
